title: RECON mismatch classes
description: Shared contract for reconciliation findings. The TypeScript engine (src/core/reconciler) implements this now; a future offline Python CLI comparing an orders CSV with a provider settlement CSV must produce findings matching this same schema and the golden fixtures in shared/fixtures, so the two can be tested for identical behavior.

findingKey.description: Stable identity: a deterministic hash of mismatchClass plus the natural keys involved (order reference / provider payment id). Must not change across reruns of the same underlying discrepancy.

evidence.description: IDs, amounts, and timestamps backing the finding - enough for a human to verify it without re-running the reconciler.

runOutcome.description: A run is INCONCLUSIVE (not 'no payment found') whenever provider data for the window was partial or unavailable - absence of a record in a partial export is never proof a payment doesn't exist.
